coreAttributes.name: 网球
coreAttributes.description: 一种由坚韧橡胶制成的充气球，专为网球运动而设计。它被纤维毡覆盖，周围有一条白色的带子，呈椭圆曲线状。
coreAttributes.equipText: [npc.Name]抓起[npc.her]手里的网球并准备扔出去。
coreAttributes.onHitEffect: #IF(npc2.getRace()==RACE_DOG_MORPH && npc2.getRaceStage()==RACE_STAGE_GREATER) [##npc2.setHealth(0)] [npc2.Name] [npc2.verb(let)] out an excited bark and [npc2.verb(chase)] after the tennis ball. Quickly grabbing hold of it, [npc2.she] [npc2.verb(roll)] onto [npc2.her] back and [npc2.verb(start)] playing with it, leaving [npc2.herHim] completely vulnerable and [style.italicsExcellent(utterly defeated)]! #ENDIF

hitDescriptions.hitText: [npc.Name]向着[npc2.name]丢出了网球，击中了[npc2.herHim]的胸口正中！
[npc.Name]把网球向着[npc2.name]丢出去，击中了[npc2.herHim]的[npc.arm(true)]！
[npc.Name]快步上前，用网球投向[npc2.name]，成功击中了[npc2.herHim]！

missDescriptions.missText: [npc.Name]向着[npc2.name]丢出了网球，但没能命中！
[npc.Name]把网球向着[npc2.name]丢出去，却没能命中目标，懊恼地叫了一声！
[npc.Name]快步上前，用网球投向[npc2.name]，但却丢歪了！

oneShotEndTurnRecoveryDescriptions.recoveryText: The tennis ball bounces back towards [npc.name], allowing [npc.herHim] to pick it up and reuse it!
